title: RQ-QSB: robust quantum score blocks under online unflagged replacements

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE RQ-QSB algorithm and exact parameter rule of proof.md recover the full s under ModelM of proof.md, including clean copies and every online unflagged replacement strategy with at most floor(Q/(131072*n)) replacements among ACTUAL Q acquired originals with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch including all retries, rejected or discarded copies, failed attempts, wrong numerical-label branches, partial inputs and either cutoff, its total charged sequential work T is O(2^((13/50)n)). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2, with the SAME all-n protocol at n=1 having finite costs absorbed by absolute constants. Its exact envelope growth index is 1. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resources and joint 1/(131072*n) fractional-tolerance declaration for this same algorithm/configuration.

For the SAME RQ-QSB algorithm/configuration as all four resource claims, the guaranteed fraction is epsilon(n)=1/(131072*n) under the exact online unflagged replacement ModelM of proof.md and the identical model text below. For every N>=2,s and every admissible strategy, with at most floor(Q/(131072*n)) replacements among the ACTUAL Q acquired originals including rejects/discards, unconditional full-secret success is at least1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. Honest copies are fresh rho_s tensor-independent of prior systems, and each replacement decision precedes the current honest draw. Bad copies may be arbitrarily correlated through private workspace; no flags are supplied. Clean input is included. No offline model or larger fraction is asserted.

structured.error_model: Online unflagged replacement model. Before each acquired copy, an adversary chooses a classical replacement bit using N, s, the past classical transcript and private quantum workspace, without access to the current fresh honest draw or future protocol coins. A non-replaced copy is a fresh rho_s tensor-independent of all prior systems; a replaced copy is any state on the same n+1 input qubits and may be entangled with private workspace and other replacements. No replacement flag is supplied. At termination Q is the actual count of all acquired copies, including rejects and discards, and at most floor(epsilon(n)*Q) were replaced almost surely for every admissible strategy; this is a promise, not postselection on budget fulfillment. Current honest labels cannot be inspected before deciding that call's type. All other gates and measurements are ideal. The probability is uniform over N,s and all such online strategies.
